title: Chebulagic acid inhibits lipopolysaccharide-induced endometritis by regulating mitogen-activated protein kinase/nuclear factor-kappaB signaling.
authors: Liu, Xinyu; Gong, Zhiguo; Yang, Ying; Dong, Jinzhong; Zhang, Lanxin; Li, Zhengyi; Zhao, Feifan; Zhang, Jianbing; Gao, Ruifeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究诃子酸通过MAPK/NF-κB信号通路抑制脂多糖诱导的子宫内膜炎，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study investigates the potential protective effects of chebulagic acid (CA) against endometritis and its underlying molecular mechanisms. Network pharmacology analysis identified 19 potential targets of CA related to endometritis, mainly associated with the mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) signaling pathways. Molecular docking analysis further indicated that MAPK14 and MAPK3 are critical targets of CA, suggesting its potential role in modulating inflammatory responses. In vitro experiments demonstrated that CA at concentrations of 12.5, 25, and 50 microg/mL significantly inhibited the secretion of proinflammatory cytokines interleukin (IL)-1beta and IL-6 in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated bovine endometrial epithelial cells (bEECs), without affecting cell viability. In vivo, CA treatment mitigated uterine inflammation in an LPS-induced mouse model of endometritis by downregulating high-mobility group box protein 1 (HMGB1) expression and inhibiting the phosphorylation of key signaling molecules, including p65, extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK), and p38. These findings suggest that CA exerts significant anti-inflammatory effects in endometritis by modulating the MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Given its potential to suppress excessive inflammatory responses, CA may serve as a promising candidate for the development of novel therapeutic strategies for endometritis.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了诃子酸（chebulagic acid, CA）对子宫内膜炎的潜在保护作用及其潜在分子机制。网络药理学分析确定了CA与子宫内膜炎相关的19个潜在靶点，主要涉及丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（mitogen-activated protein kinase, MAPK）信号通路。分子对接分析进一步表明，MAPK14和MAPK3是CA的关键靶点，提示其在调节炎症反应中可能发挥作用。体外实验表明，浓度为12.5、25和50微克/毫升的CA显著抑制了脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）刺激的牛子宫内膜上皮细胞（bovine endometrial epithelial cells, bEECs）中促炎细胞因子白细胞介素（interleukin, IL）-1β和IL-6的分泌，且不影响细胞活力。在体内，CA处理通过下调高迁移率族蛋白B1（high-mobility group box protein 1, HMGB1）表达并抑制关键信号分子（包括p65、细胞外信号调节激酶（extracellular signal-regulated kinase, ERK）和p38）的磷酸化，减轻了LPS诱导的小鼠子宫内膜炎模型中的子宫炎症。这些发现表明，CA通过调节MAPK/NF-κB信号通路在子宫内膜炎中发挥显著的抗炎作用。鉴于其抑制过度炎症反应的潜力，CA可能作为开发子宫内膜炎新型治疗策略的有前景候选药物。
